title.en: AN ACT DECLARING THE BARRIOS OF SAN MODESTO, SAN NARCISO, SAN EUGENIO, SAN ATANASIO, AND PART OF THE BARRIO OF SAN JOSE, NOW A PART OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN NICOLAS, THE BARRIOS OF SAN ROQUE, SAN HIPOLITO, AND A PART OF SAN JOSE, NOW A PART OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF TAYUG, AND THE SITIO OF ANTOLIN, NOW A PART OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN QUINTIN, ALL OF THE PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN, TO BE A NEW MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF NATIVIDAD.

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập đô thị mới Natividad từ các barrio San Modesto, San Narciso, San Eugenio, San Atanasio và một phần barrio San Jose thuộc đô thị San Nicolas; các barrio San Roque, San Hipolito và một phần San Jose thuộc đô thị Tayug; và sitio Antolin thuộc đô thị San Quintin, tất cả đều ở tỉnh Pangasinan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้บารังไกย์ซานโมเดสโต ซานนาร์ซิโซ ซานยูเจนิโอ ซานอาตาเนซิโอ และส่วนหนึ่งของบารังไกย์ซานโฮเซ่ซึ่งปัจจุบันเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเทศบาลซานนิโคลัส บารังไกย์ซานโรเก้ ซานอิโปลิโต และส่วนหนึ่งของซานโฮเซ่ซึ่งปัจจุบันเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเทศบาลเทยูก และไซติโออันโตลินซึ่งปัจจุบันเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเทศบาลซานควินติน ทั้งหมดในจังหวัดปังกาซินัน เป็นเทศบาลใหม่ภายใต้ชื่อนาติวิดัด
title.id: Undang-Undang Menetapkan Barrio San Modesto, San Narciso, San Eugenio, San Atanasio, dan sebagian Barrio San Jose yang kini merupakan bagian dari Kotamadya San Nicolas; Barrio San Roque, San Hipolito, dan sebagian San Jose yang kini merupakan bagian dari Kotamadya Tayug; serta Sitio Antolin yang kini merupakan bagian dari Kotamadya San Quintin, semuanya di Provinsi Pangasinan, sebagai Kotamadya Baru bernama Natividad
title.ms: Akta Menjadikan Barrio San Modesto, San Narciso, San Eugenio, San Atanasio dan sebahagian Barrio San Jose yang kini merupakan bahagian Kotamadya San Nicolas; Barrio San Roque, San Hipolito dan sebahagian San Jose yang kini merupakan bahagian Kotamadya Tayug; dan Sitio Antolin yang kini merupakan bahagian Kotamadya San Quintin, kesemuanya di Wilayah Pangasinan, sebagai Kotamadya Baharu bernama Natividad

text.en:
The barrios of San Modesto, San Narciso, San Eugenio, San Atanasio, and that part of the barrio
of San Jose de Nicolas lying on the left or eastward bank of the Estero Lacab, now forming a part of the
municipality of San Nicolas, the barrios of San Roque, San Hipolito, and the easterly half of the barrio of
San Jose de Tayug, as determined by the survey hereinafter ordered, now forming a part of the municipality
of Tayug, and the sitio of Antolin, now forming a part of the municipality of San Quintin, with the lands
adjacent thereto, all in and of the Province of Pangasinan, Island of Luzon, are hereby separated, each from
its corresponding municipality, and shall be organized as a new municipality under the name of Natividad, as
hereinafter provided.

The provincial supervisor shall survey at once the new municipality, in order to establish in a
definite and precise manner the boundary lines which separate it from the adjacent municipalities, and shall
report to the provincial board the results of such survey. After the provincial supervisor has established the
boundary lines of the municipality and has reported to the provincial board, the provincial governor shall
direct the holding of a municipal election in said municipality in accordance with the provisions of sections
ninety-one, ninety-two, ninety-three, and ninety-four of the Municipal Code.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.

Enacted, March 7, 1902.
